metadata.title: Monolithic Roman Numeral with Script Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A glossy black 3D Roman numeral 'II' featuring a central horizontal band with elegant script text, illuminated by a radiant blue backlight.
triggerTerms: glossy black emblem with blue glow

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, glossy black 3D Roman numeral 'II' stands as the central subject. A thick, beveled horizontal band wraps around the middle of the numeral, split into two arrow-like segments pointing toward the center. The entire structure is backlit by a vibrant blue light that creates a halo effect and highlights the sharp, beveled edges of the black material. Elegant white script lettering is centered on the horizontal bands.
coreVisualRelationships: The Roman numeral 'II' acts as the primary structural frame.
The horizontal band segments create a focal point for the typography.
The blue backlight provides high-contrast separation for the black silhouette.
The glossy finish reflects the surrounding light to define 3D volume.
coreInvariants: The Roman numeral 'II' must be rendered as a 3D slab-serif structure with beveled edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The Roman numeral is centered and fills approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central horizontal band where the script text is located.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright blue center, moves outward to the script text, and then follows the vertical lines of the numeral.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The corners and edges of the frame are filled with a blue gradient and light rays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue gradient background with radiant light rays.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the script typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, reflective black surfaces and the luminous blue background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Formal script with high stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'B' and 'M' feature large, circular loops.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The fluid script provides a soft contrast to the rigid, geometric 3D Roman numeral.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast swashes of the original.
Provides a similar formal calligraphic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D glossy black Roman numeral 'II' with beveled edges and a central horizontal band, set against a radiant blue background with light rays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white formal script text centered on the horizontal bands of the 3D structure.

verificationChecks: Is the Roman numeral 'II' clearly 3D and glossy?
Is the blue light radiating from behind the numeral?
Is the script text white and legible against the black band?

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetry in the Roman numeral structure.
Ensure the blue glow does not wash out the white text.
Verify the 3D perspective is consistent across the numeral and band.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a monolithic 3D geometric symbol with a contrasting elegant script overlay, unified by a dramatic single-color backlight.
